Maria K.: main just went red right after the merge from commit 3df1c9 -> 4a7b2e, smoke + gpu-matrix failing. Link: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/32211
CI Bot: [automated] pipeline status: FAILED (smoke-gpu-matrix) job: smoke-gpu-14, test failure: tests/integration/test_kv_alloc.py::test_kv_alloc - see logs: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/32211/logs
Dan B.: who owns the smoke-gpu job? @siva?
Siva R.: on it, starting bisect. first step: rerun failing job to confirm flaky vs reproducible. running: `./scripts/ci/rerun_job.sh smoke-gpu -r 4a7b2e`
Dan B.: thx. if it reproduces, can you capture the exact failing test and stack?
Siva R.: rerun finished, same failure: `tests/integration/test_kv_alloc.py::test_kv_alloc` - reproduces on gpu-shard-02. attaching short log excerpt in case: "OOM while allocating 1.2GB for kvcache"
Leo T.: assigning to Siva. I can pull kernel and container logs from the node. @ops-oncall please hold nodes while we triage.
ops-oncall: ack, isolating gpu-shard-02, collecting dmesg + nvidia-smi output, will paste when ready
CI Bot: bisect task started by Siva R. id=bisection-9987 range=[5500..5560]
Siva R.: bisect narrowed to PR range 5528..5536. PR 5532 touched kvalloc allocator and shard packing. running local quick revert test now.
Maria K.: if revert is the only safe fix, prefer quick revert to unblock main. target turnaround 30m.
Dan B.: agreed. if revert lands, add regression test and link to PR for follow-up root cause. ping @release-coordinator for awareness.
Siva R.: local test with revert patch `revert-kvalloc-5532` passed smoke on my laptop (small replica). opening revert PR: https://git.redwood.example/p/r/5599
Maria K.: :thumbsup: prioritizing CI for that PR, please mark it P0 in PR description.
CI Bot: PR 5599 build queued (priority: P0)
Leo T.: ops-oncall, any signs of hardware flakiness or is this purely software?
ops-oncall: so far node logs show consistent OOM at 15:42:03 UTC, no GPU hardware errors. kube OOM killer invoked inside container. collecting full stacktrace now.
Siva R.: creating the revert branch and will merge once CI is green on the revert. If CI flakes again, will escalate to rollback + gate changes.
Dan B.: if revert doesn't merge within 20m, we should consider manual rollout pause on autodeploy. who can flip the gate? @release-coordinator or ops?
Maria K.: I'll coordinate pause if needed. for now let's let Siva try revert. post-merge, please follow up with a short incident note listing reproducer, suspect PR, and next steps.
Siva R.: merge done (revert PR 5599). post-merge CI run now: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/32237
CI Bot: pipeline status: SUCCESS (post-merge smoke) for commit 4a7b2e-revert-5599
Leo T.: great. ops-oncall please continue collecting logs for root cause analysis.
ops-oncall: logs uploaded: https://logs.redwood.example/archived/32211-32237, will forward to Siva.
Maria K.: thanks all. reopening a small follow-up: add a non-flaky regression test for kvalloc edge case and schedule a short RCA session tomorrow.
Dan B.: noted. adding to eng-infra backlog and tagging owners.
Siva R.: will write the RCA and include the bisection notes + reproducer command.
Maria K.: closing this thread once RCA link posted. :white_check_mark:
